payload.blocks: Only step 2 (live check) of phase 6 of plan 261124-2143; steps 1 and 4 run now. The plan cannot close without it.
payload.headline: Who runs the live lead-ended check of plan 261124-2143? It needs a new release and a killed agent process

parts.cause: The activated release (2026-11-25 11:42) predates the lands of phases 2-4, so the check must follow a new release; my release run got land-in-progress. Killing a process is outside my confinement and lead:SUPERVISOR is not reachable from here (as in q-lquw5eeksv).

options.cost: One release and one throwaway session.
options.does: After `fgos release run` reports released: `fgos session start lead --name livecheck-lead-ended`; kill that session's agent process (pid from its pane); `fgos watcher tick`; `fgos supervisor queue` shows lead-ended; `fgos session stop lead --name livecheck-lead-ended --reason "live check"`; paste the output into the report path above.
options.gain: The plan closes today with real live evidence.
options.harm: About ten minutes of your time.
options.label: You run it in an unconfined shell

options.does: You hand the same commands to the unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session.
options.gain: No hands-on time for you beyond the paste.
options.harm: Waits until that session is free.
options.label: Paste the job to lead:SUPERVISOR

options.does: The plan closes on its unit and integration tests; a backlog row keeps the live check.
options.harm: The host end signal is never seen working live.
options.label: Close without the live check

parts.recommendation: You run it in an unconfined shell, after the next release: only a live kill proves the end signal, and nothing here can kill a process.

scope.allows: One release, one throwaway lead session started, killed and stopped, and the report write.
scope.forbids: Stopping or killing any real lead or other session.

parts.what: Phase 6 step 2 must start a throwaway lead, kill its agent process, run one watcher tick, see lead-ended in `fgos supervisor queue`, then stop it, recording output in plans/261124-2143-head-lifecycle-events/reports/integration.md.
